title: Derive proposal outcome totals from frozen specifications
failure_signature: The first x1 generator declared 21 completed and 7 represented outcomes while the specifications contained 23 and 5.
trigger_preconditions: A proposal table and declared aggregate are authored separately.
candidate_workaround: Count expected dispositions directly from the frozen proposal table and fail before writing if the declared aggregate differs.
recurrence_guard: Never change proposal evidence labels to satisfy a preferred distribution; derive the distribution from proposal truth.
rollback: Retain the failed generator attempt and write no packet until the aggregate matches the frozen table.
scope_boundary: Preregistration accounting only; no x2 or empirical credit.
